run_selfplay_training: run the selfplay training loop for Hanabi DQN with VDN or IQL multi-agent methods
parse_args_cli: parse command line arguments for Hanabi DQN training including learning rate, batch size, and replay buffer settings
create_envs_games: create Hanabi game environments with configurable player count, hand size, and exploration epsilon decay
train_r2d2_agent: train an R2D2 agent with prioritized replay buffer and LSTM-based recurrent network on Hanabi selfplay
evaluate_agent_score: evaluate the trained agent on Hanabi games and save top-k models by score
